constants:
mkdir -p benchmarks/baseline

# Try to download from the benchmark-data branch. Read via FETCH_HEAD,
# not origin/benchmark-data - a plain `git fetch` always updates
# FETCH_HEAD, but whether it also updates the origin/benchmark-data
# remote-tracking ref depends on actions/checkout's configured fetch
# refspec, which isn't guaranteed.
#
# Reads results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json - this job's OWN baseline,
# updated by this same workflow's "Record results" step below on
# every push to main, NOT release.yml's baseline (which moved to
# results/macos-arm64/ when the release benchmark job migrated to
# the self-hosted Mac Mini runner - comparing a ubuntu-latest PR run
# against a macOS-Mini release baseline would be exactly the kind of
# apples-to-oranges mismatch that migration was meant to eliminate).
git fetch origin benchmark-data

if git show FETCH_HEAD:results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json > benchmarks/baseline/baseline.json.tmp; then
  mv benchmarks/baseline/baseline.json.tmp benchmarks/baseline/baseline.json
  # Capture provenance for the PR comment: the recording commit's
  # subject names the main commit these numbers were measured for
  # ("chore: record benchmark results for <sha> (ubuntu-latest)").
  PROV_SUBJECT=$(git log -1 --format='%s' FETCH_HEAD -- results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json)
  PROV_DATE=$(git log -1 --format='%cs' FETCH_HEAD -- results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json)
  PROV_COMMIT=$(echo "$PROV_SUBJECT" | sed -n 's/.*for \([0-9a-f]\{7,40\}\).*/\1/p')
  echo "last \`main\` benchmark run (main commit \`${PROV_COMMIT:-unknown}\`, recorded ${PROV_DATE}, ubuntu-latest runner)" > benchmarks/baseline/provenance.txt
  echo "Baseline results downloaded from benchmark-data"
else
  rm -f benchmarks/baseline/baseline.json.tmp
  echo "No baseline results found"
fi

constants:
RESULTS_FILE="$(pwd)/benchmarks/${{ steps.run_benchmark.outputs.results_file }}"

git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

git fetch origin benchmark-data
git worktree add -B benchmark-data /tmp/benchmark-data FETCH_HEAD

mkdir -p /tmp/benchmark-data/results/ubuntu-latest
cp "$RESULTS_FILE" "/tmp/benchmark-data/results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json"

cd /tmp/benchmark-data
git add results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json
# Nothing to commit if this push's numbers happen to produce a
# byte-identical file to what's already recorded (possible for a
# docs-only/comment-only change matching the path filters above) -
# skip rather than create an empty commit.
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "results/ubuntu-latest/latest.json unchanged - skipping commit"
else
  git commit -m "chore: record benchmark results for $(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" rev-parse --short HEAD) (ubuntu-latest)"
  git push origin HEAD:benchmark-data
fi
